evidence.why: Shows the normal four-word stage-SFX command and the target's suppression implementation.
Shows nonzero animation starts choosing the alternate command interpreter.
Shows the target performing no operation other than `SKIP_CMD(cmd, 4)`.

facts.value: During motion-state entry at a nonzero animation start frame, `Fighter_ChangeMotionState` runs the alternate command interpreter to advance through commands already due at that frame. If it encounters opcode 39, this handler consumes all four words while deliberately omitting the normal stage-SFX playback; command interpretation then continues from the next event.
facts.rationale: Current motion-state code retains the nonzero-start branch, the alternate interpreter retains its due-command loop and opcode rebase, and the target remains a four-word no-op consumer.

evidence.why: Shows nonzero animation starts invoking `ftAction_80073354`.
Shows the alternate interpreter executing currently due commands through its alternate callback table.
Shows the target consuming all four words without an audio or gameplay side effect.
